boundaries: Passing repeated stereo means satisfying existing two-pair and tolerance gates, not verified correct geometry. Repeated pairs share the same anchor and can share systematic errors.
Whole-scene counts include rig, support and pots. Diagnostic P1/P4 boxes include background and neighbouring structures. They are not manual plant segmentation or completeness estimates.
Counts repeat surfaces across anchors; cannot add them to final cloud count as unique recovered geometry.
Stereo stack contains only pair outputs after LR-consistency, speckle, uniqueness and range filtering. Missing candidates cannot be uniquely attributed among these causes without controlled reruns.

Nominal disparity ROI is OpenCV getValidDisparityROI for full rectified images. It can differ from the actual signed SGBM search-column formula, which is recorded separately from implementation source. Remapping, overlap and masks further limit usable pixels. Neither statistic alone attributes observed holes.
Depths and baselines retain the current conditional metre scale. No manual trait value or arbitrary board size was used.
No gates changed; ROI removal or shorter-baseline experiments require held-out evidence and failure review.

fusion_stage_counts.interpretation: These are unique extracted TSDF vertices, a different counting unit from the stereo pixel-view table. Rejected visibility points were not preserved, so unsupported-versus-conflict causes cannot be separated from current outputs. All statistical rejections are preserved by supported-cloud index mapping.
